dogecoin.text:
Bitcoin's mooning past 100K, Solana's flexing, Dogecoin's barking loud.  
Meme coins pump, NFT degens dump.  
Elon's silent, Vitalik's plotting.  
DeFi's eating TradFi's lunch.  
HODL or get rekt, noobs.

Meme coins pumping while L1s bleed?  
Typical crypto circus.  
Little Pepe's building a blockchain empire,  
and Dogecoin's still shilling vibes.  
Vitalik's quiet, Elon's teasing DOGE again.  
Pick your poison, degens -  
this market's a savage meme fest.
